title: Evaluation data, grouping and contamination
outcome: Build a reproducible family/time split and detect identifier, near-duplicate and availability-time leakage before scoring.

exercises.title: Split paraphrases
exercises.task: Put two paraphrases from one family into train and test.
exercises.hint: Group by the dependency that the deployment claim must cross.
exercises.answer: Row-level randomization can leak family-specific information. Entire groups must stay together under this protocol.

exercises.title: Include cutoff equality
exercises.task: Use event and label times exactly equal to the cutoff.
exercises.expected: The row is eligible under the stated inclusive policy.
exercises.answer: Boundary inclusion is a protocol choice. Here both observations are available at the cutoff and the validator uses an inclusive rule.

exercises.title: Reject a delayed label
exercises.hint: Event time does not imply information availability.
exercises.answer: The target was unknown at deployment, so using it in training would be retrospective leakage.

exercises.title: Separate normalization from meaning
exercises.task: Compare fingerprints of rate and rates.
exercises.hint: This normalizer handles case and whitespace only.
exercises.answer: A digest equality test is not a semantic paraphrase detector. Its known false negatives should be documented.

exercises.title: Version the retrieval corpus
exercises.task: Explain why a document corrected after the cutoff needs another corpus version.
exercises.expected: Historical evaluation uses the earlier available version.
exercises.hint: Ask what the system could have observed then.
exercises.answer: A later correction can change answer correctness and evidence. Preserve snapshot identity rather than silently substituting current content.

exercises.title: Audit an empty partition
exercises.task: Create a valid group assignment with an empty test partition.
exercises.expected: Grouping validation alone is insufficient for an evaluation.
exercises.hint: Distinguish structural validity from adequate coverage.
exercises.answer: The split guard accepts no conflicting groups, but a separate coverage gate must reject an empty final assessment.
